name: ios-seek-text
prompt: Tap once on the white "Seek" text TWO controls to the LEFT of the narrow label that looks like "Seel". The "Seel" label is immediately to the left of the rightmost two-line "Seek Huge" control. There is exactly one other "Seek" control between your target and "Seel". Your target is Seek Text, whose suffix is intrinsically clipped. These controls are in the blue seek row directly below Clear / Play / Play Null / Pause / Stop and above Src A / Src B. Click within the white text itself, not in a neighboring control. If this row is visible, do not scroll; scrolling cannot unclip these labels. Stop after that single tap.
